events.facility_name: Juaymah NGL facility / LPG export terminal
events.summary: Aramco said damage at Juaymah on 23 February 2026 halted LPG exports from the site, and declared force majeure on shipments.
events.effect: LPG export loadings from Juaymah halted; force majeure declared.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 2: operator-confirmed suspension of energy (LPG) export loadings.

review.process: Found by a research lane; then reviewed blind by three independent reviewers, none of whom saw the researcher's rationale or each other: one opened the sources and checked identity, date, region, threshold and every figure; one checked the text for placement finer than first-level region, inventories, dependency and status wording; one checked class, cause, hazard name, episode and duplicates. Published only because all three accepted it; their corrections were reconciled into this text.
review.source_access: not recorded by the research lane

publication.note: Attacks on this country's energy facilities are still being reported. Saying whether a struck facility is back in operation could help time another attack, so the event is published but the facility's restart, recovery and operating status are not, nor are reports of them, until the campaign has ended.

events.summary: Aramco shut the Ras Tanura refinery as a precaution while assessing damage after an attack.
events.effect: Refinery shut down (energy ministry statement via state news agency, as reported by Bloomberg): shut "as a precaution while assessing damage."
events.threshold_basis: Clause 1: refinery shut down after an attack, per official statement.

capacity_affected.source_says: Bloomberg/World Oil: the 550,000 b/d refinery was shut.

events.summary: The energy ministry reported on 9 April 2026 that an earlier attack on the Khurais facility cut its production capacity by about 300,000 b/d. The attack date was not given and may precede April.
events.effect: Production capacity reduced by about 300,000 b/d (ministry: "أدى إلى انخفاض إنتاجه بمقدار 300 ألف برميل يوميًا من طاقته الإنتاجية").
events.threshold_basis: Clause 7: official statement of production curtailed by a stated material volume.

capacity_affected.source_says: Energy ministry source via SPA, 9 Apr 2026: an earlier attack on Khurais reduced its output by 300,000 b/d of its production capacity.
